description: Privacy-friendly, login-free Chrome & Edge extension for exchange rates: market quotes, central-bank reference rates for 30+ currencies, trend charts, a watchlist and in-page conversion. Works out of the box — data refreshes every 4 hours on GitHub Pages, no server or API key needed.
